summary.text: Sarah Clark is the incumbent Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 136 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former deputy state director for U.S. Senator Kirsten Gillibrand, she was sworn into the Assembly in November 2020 and chairs the Majority Conference.

paragraphs.text: Clark is a lifelong Rochester resident who graduated from East High School and SUNY Stony Brook.
She worked for over 20 years in the U.S. Senate, first for Senator Hillary Clinton and then as Senator Kirsten Gillibrand's Deputy State Director.
Clark was sworn in to the Assembly on November 12, 2020, and represents the 136th District, which covers Irondequoit, Brighton and parts of the City of Rochester.
According to her official biography, she is Chair of the Majority Conference and Secretary of the bipartisan Legislative Women's Caucus.
She is a member of the Children and Families, Education, Energy, Higher Education, Local Governments, and Small Business committees.

Her official biography lists affordable child care, senior care, education access and anti-poverty policy among her legislative priorities, and notes her 2025 sponsorship of the Student Lifeline Act on student mental health resources.
